claims.note: Corazzol (on Recanati's Zohar-based Kabbalah, 457): the tenth sefirah, when connected, receives the influence of 'the fourth sefirah, i.e. piety'; when separated it receives 'the maleficent influence of the fifth sefirah ... it is then called "Middat ha-Din [the property of Judgment]", which inflicts calamity upon the world'. Calamity follows the tenth sefirah's separation, not the fifth sefirah's 'acting alone'; the 'it' named Middat ha-Din may be the tenth sefirah. Fourth = piety and fifth = maleficent are supported.
